\section{A flag inside a verbatim environment}

In prose I write a hyphen and nothing else. Inside the environment below the
double hyphen is a flag and TeX will not typeset it as a ligature, so it
stands as written.

\begin{verbatim}
bash scripts/regression-baseline.sh --check
ninja -C build check-npu
\end{verbatim}

\begin{lstlisting}
npu-opt --split-input-file --verify-diagnostics input.mlir
\end{lstlisting}

\begin{minted}{bash}
reuse lint --quiet
\end{minted}

A comment is not typeset either, so this one is fine: % --check --self-test
